title: Distributed Token Bucket & Leaky Bucket Rate Limiting
learningObjectives: Understand Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket, and Sliding Window Counter algorithms
Implement atomic distributed rate limiting using Redis Lua scripts
Return standard IETF draft RateLimit headers (`RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`)
keyTradeoffs: Fixed window memory efficiency vs sliding window boundary burst protection
Local in-process rate limiting vs central distributed Redis evaluation
commonPitfalls: Non-atomic get-and-increment operations in Redis that cause race conditions under high concurrency
Failing to include `Retry-After` headers on HTTP 429 Too Many Requests responses
transferPrompt: How do you layer monthly subscription quota limits on top of second-by-second burst rate limiting?
